pr_body:
The compiler thinks t may be used unitialized sometimes. Let's initialize it to NULL.

Fixes #71814
pr_comments:
> Are we sure that we aren't masking real issue here?

There is likely other issues in that code. I can send another PR just reverting the commit..

Closing as revert was done instead.
Thanks all for the reviews

> Are we sure that we aren't masking real issue here? The issue is that if asserts are disabled, then there is a possibility that the uninitialized variable is used later. It seems to happen quite regularly with the `K_SPINLOCK()` and similar macros. We don't expect the failure case to ever be encountered, but under some condition, the compiler complains. What bothers me here is that Zephyr CI never catches this particular class of issue. Literally never. Similarly, when running tests manually with `twister`, I never see this issue. @nashif just informed me about https://merge-list.zephyrproject.io/ which I can't even access due to certificate issues. > There is likely other issues in that code. Maybe more of the same. It would be great to catch these before they are merged. Any ideas @stephanosio, @fabiobaltieri ? Are there some additional flags that I could pass to `twister` to see this happen during manual testing? Or better yet, is there a way for us to run CI with these flags?

issue_context.title: tests/net/all fails in CI due to build warning
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
tests/net/all  (and others that build with CONFIG_PTHREAD) will build with a warning.
Given CI treating warnings as errors this will fail CI.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. mkdir build && cd build
2. cmake -GNinja -DBOARD=qemu_x86 ../tests/net/all
2. ninja
4. See error

**Expected behavior**
No build warnings

**Impact**
Failing CI in main and for PRs which trigger these tests.

**Logs and console output**
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/actions/runs/8799555855/job/24148965903#step:11:531

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Linux (Ubuntu 22.04)
 - Toolchain Zephyr SDK
 - Commit SHA or Version used: main as of now a1dd9a5f6e562a11edc238e3af76dd64caddca83

**Additional context**
Introduced by 6e66aa1f7c15792a4f173355d05f6feb907811e5

review_comments:
Does this really fix it? 

If it things that `t` is uninitialized, doesn't it now just think we are de-referencing a NULL pointer in `LOG_DBG("Pthread %p detached", &t->thread);`?
there is a null check just below.

You mean the one on line 1129?

If the compiler understands that, then it should also understand `t = to_posix_thread(pthread);` on the line above, which sounds like being the issue here?

Maybe, but it would fail just like if it failed in line 1128.
I'm not trying to fix this code overall. Just fix the regression that is failing CI.
